text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae declared her ambition to 
challenge the international GⅠ held in 
Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Along with her desire to make Tomakomai 
famous, her refusal to lose to Copano 
Rickey also seemed to have pushed her 
forward to take on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, according to feng shui, the 
direction of Hokko Tarumae's expedition 
was an ominous one. Copano Rickey 
regretted silently seeing her off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And—the worst fears came true. Hokko 
Tarumae suffered a crushing defeat, 
returning home in despair... Furthermore, 
it was announced she would be taking a 
hiatus.
